notes.title: Update b2.11
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Bug fix - Par value wasn't showing upon resetting save data until completing level
[*] Level editor gamepad controls finished
[*] General bugfixes
[/list]

notes.title: Update b2.8 (In-game shown as b2.5)
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Various bugfixes
[*] New level icon shown when achieving par value (only level 1 has a par set so far)
[*] Pressing space or enter brings up menu selection boxes (same as pressing A on a controller)
[*] Changed how levels are unlocked - One at a time normally, 2 extra if bonus collected
[*] The door now shows a checkmark if a played level has already been completed
[*] Altered the checkmark on a previously collected bonus to match the style of checkmark used on doors, also more legible than the previous version
[/list]

notes.title: Important Update Notice
notes.content: Upon several requests, I went ahead and continued updates for the public default beta demo build.  I just released b2.5, which may or may not break compatibility with previous save data.  If you lost progress or have any issues running the game after this update due to conflicts with previous save data, please contact me and I will assist you in resolving it.  Please let me know if you have any questions or concerns.

notes.title: Update b2.5
notes.content:
Major update - Save paths updated
[list]
[*] Help screen added
[*] Confirmation for exit and restart level
[*] Additional levels added
[*] Save system revamped - My require manual migration of old save data
[*] General bugfixes
[*] Ending credits added
[/list]

Please contact me if you need assistance getting the new build working after migrating from previous version
